english: After having spent whole mornings on the river, I always go home with an empty bag.
text: whole mornings 指一次次耗去整个上午，和 always go home 相配，讲的是反复出现的结果。After having spent 把时间投入放在返家之前；换成 After spending 也自然，不必把这种习惯描写误作某一次钓鱼。
